references.label: Proxima Centauri
references.note: The nearest star. BLC1, a 2019 candidate signal seen toward it with the Parkes telescope, turned out to be interference.

references.label: Barnard's Star
references.note: One of the nearest stars, in Ophiuchus like Voyager 1.

references.label: Tau Ceti
references.note: A Sun-like star; one of the two targets of Project Ozma, the first radio SETI search (1960).

references.label: TRAPPIST-1
references.note: Seven Earth-sized planets; searched by Breakthrough Listen with the Green Bank Telescope.

references.label: Galactic Centre
references.note: Sagittarius A*; Breakthrough Listen surveyed the region with the Green Bank Telescope.
